findings.trigger: A structured part target also has an explicit A11y snapshot.id; the host changes target.id while the binding stays live.
findings.observed: The newly installed document observer calls update with the cached semantic snapshot. Scalar reacquisition and applySnapshot at lines 650–657 restore snapshot.id over the new host id before reservation reconciliation. Measured proto-id -> host-later -> proto-id after MutationObserver delivery, without a manual projector call.
findings.expected: Preserve the host-authored new value; withdraw the previous dependent contribution and perform collision checks before adopting or rebinding.
findings.impact: The host-authored current identity is erased while the relation continues pointing to the old identity. Existing authored labels or external references to the new ID break.
findings.fix: Separate observed host identity reconciliation from stale scalar snapshot replay and cover the explicit-A11y-ID plus structured-part combination.

findings.trigger: A generated-ID structured-part target shares its physical element with another logical projector that declares a different explicit ID.
findings.observed: The writer synchronously produces the required fail-closed controls=null, but the new document observer later treats the independent scalar write as host-authored identity and reselects the generated owner reservation. Measured original pui-a11y-1 -> independent-id, controls null -> independent-id after observer delivery. Disposing the writer then retains independent-id rather than recovering pui-a11y-1.
findings.expected: Preserve independent scalar ownership while keeping the original generated reservation unavailable during a different-ID takeover; writer release should recover the original identity as governed by existing PUI-625-GENERATED-ID-SURVIVOR-RELEASE coverage (web-reference.test.ts:675–721).
findings.impact: Independent projector ownership is conflated with host authorship and a logical target silently changes its retained identity, breaking the existing direct-reference compatibility boundary.
findings.fix: Exclude current independent scalar-owned ID values from host-authored mutation rebinding; retain the old logical reservation until the independent writer releases it.
